articleTitle: Leveraging Machine Learning to Analyze Socioeconomic Disparities in U.S Cancer Clinical Trials
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Cancer affects various segments of the U.S. population, but certain groups face a more significant burden because of social, environmental, and economic hardships. Using machine-learning techniques and the County-Level Socioeconomic and Cancer Clinical Trial Data, this study investigates the relationship between socioeconomic variables and the availability of cancer clinical trials in U.S. counties. Our research shows notable differences in trial availability according to socioeconomic parameters, including poverty rates, median income, and mortality rates. While the other methods demonstrated initial accuracies of 72.79%, 67.16%, and 62.25%, gradient boosting achieved approximately 75% prediction accuracy. These understandings can be used to focus therapies better, enhance healthcare equity, and enhance the results of cancer treatment.

articleTitle: Smart Contracts: Classification Problems
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: The article analyzes modern approaches to the classification of smart contracts used in blockchain ecosystems. Functional, legal and technical classifications, their advantages and disadvantages are considered. A hybrid classification model is proposed that takes into account autonomy, legal status and compatibility between blockchain platforms. The study demonstrates the need for further standardization of smart contracts for their effective use in the economy and legal sphere.

articleTitle: NSGA-II Based Optimization of LLC Resonant Converter for 270V to 28V DC-DC Conversion in More Electric Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: The increasing demand for More Electric Aircraft (MEA) has increased the need for efficient and compact power converters in aircraft power distribution systems. Although conventional Buck converters offer simplicity, they face limitations in aerospace applications due to efficiency constraints and thermal management challenges. To address these issues, this paper proposes a multi-objective optimized LLC resonant converter by NSGA-II method for 270V DC to 28V DC conversion in aerospace systems. The Pareto Frontier is used to visualize the optimization results to select the optimal design, and the accuracy of the optimized LLC converter is verified by simulations. The results show that the proposed converter meets the stringent requirements of modern aerospace applications, making it a promising alternative to conventional Buck converters for aerospace applications. For aerospace applications, an LLC converter design that can operate in the input voltage range of 250 V to 280 V DC and provide a 28 V DC output voltage with 280 W output power has been realized and verified by simulation studies.

articleTitle: Crypto Code Constructions in Post-Quantum Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: The development of a full-scale quantum computer calls into question the stability of modern cryptosystems. Thus, all asymmetric cryptosystems can be compromised (hacked) based on Shor's quantum algorithm (possibly also digital signature algorithms on asymmetric cryptosystems, including those using elliptic curve cryptography). Using Grover's quantum algorithm will be able to hack symmetric encryption algorithms, including the AES-128 cipher. In the conditions of the post-quantum period of evolution, algorithms of post-quantum cryptography are developing. Among the winners of the NIST competition for algorithms of post-quantum cryptography, a special place is occupied by crypto-code structures that not only ensure authenticity, but are also capable of integrated confidentiality and integrity. At the same time, the use of noise-resistant codes allows "additional" provision of reliability. In addition, in terms of the speed of cryptographic transformations, crypto-code structures provide a speed at the level of modern algorithms of symmetric cryptography.

articleTitle: Solar Energy and Supercapacitor Integration: Efficient Energy Storage Solutions
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive simulationbased design of a solar-powered energy storage system that employs a supercapacitor for rapid charge–discharge dynamics. The proposed system integrates a buck converter, a Perturb & Observe (P&O) maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithm, and an overvoltage protection (OVP) circuit to ensure efficient and safe energy transfer. A physical model of the photovoltaic (PV) module is adopted to capture irradiance and temperature variations, thereby providing realistic performance insights. Simulation results demonstrate that the P&O-based MPPT scheme effectively extracts the maximum possible power under varying conditions, while the OVP mechanism reliably safeguards the supercapacitor from overcharging. The supercapacitor itself exhibits stable short- and long-term voltage responses, validated through controlled charging and discharging events. These findings highlight the suitability of supercapacitors for intermittent solar applications requiring high power density, rapid transients management, and extended life cycles.

articleTitle: A Computer Vision-Based Physical Activity Application for Children with Autism
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a neurological condition characterized by challenges in social interaction, communication, repetitive behaviors, and restricted interests. While the exact cause remains unknown, ASD results from genetic and environmental factors and persists throughout life. Early diagnosis and intervention enhance quality of life and potential. Games have proven effective in nurturing socialization, skill acquisition, and adaptability in children with ASD, leveraging their structured and visually appealing design.This study adopted a game-based approach to support motor skills, socialization, and learning in children with ASD. Using computer vision techniques, children’s movements were captured via cameras and transformed into interactive virtual characters in real time. Activities included movement mimicry games to improve attention and motor skills, dance games for physical coordination, and turn-based games to enhance social skills. The system, developed in this study using Google MediaPipe Pose and Unity, is cost-effective and suitable for preschools and home use. Feedback from educators at the Autism Sports and Life Center guided system refinement. The work presented in this article offers a robust foundation for fostering independence and social participation in children with ASD.

articleTitle: Human Face Localization in 3D For Humanoid Robot Vision
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Reliable three-dimensional localization of human locations is critical in a variety of computer vision applications, including robots, self-driving automobiles, security, and human-computer interaction. This research focuses on improving the vision system of Arslan humanoid robot and allows it to maintain a constant connection with people in its field of view. The system uses human binocular vision principles to extract depth information from photos taken with two pan cameras calibrated with servo motors for accurate angle alignment, as well as two identical USB cameras. The methodology consists of taking photos, recognizing faces, comparing face counts amongst cameras, and conducting 3D localization. The basic goals are to keep eye contact with individuals, estimate their approximate locations, and correctly establish their precise places. Methodological breakthroughs have greatly increased localization accuracy, lowering mistakes and increasing dependability. These advancements open the door for more responsive and intuitive human-computer interactions, benefiting the larger area of computer vision technology

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to ADHD Detection Using Handwriting and Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder that begins in childhood and persists throughout life. Currently, there are no auxiliary tests, studies, or biomarkers with sufficient predictive power to confirm or exclude ADHD. Existing diagnostic methods, such as functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), are both cumbersome and highly challenging for children. However, simpler methods could assist in diagnosing ADHD more effectively. In this study, significant results were achieved by utilizing handwriting for ADHD diagnosis through a very brief and straightforward process. A sentence written by a child on paper was successfully classified using image processing techniques and an intelligent model. The developed model serves as an assistive tool for medical experts by enabling preliminary diagnosis and early detection of ADHD. This study aims to both accelerate the diagnostic process and facilitate early diagnosis of ADHD. The obtained results demonstrate that preliminary diagnosis can be performed in a simple and rapid manner using handwriting analysis and image processing techniques.

articleTitle: Assessment of Electromagnetic Forces in Transformers Under Open-Circuit and Short-Circuit Conditions
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Transformers are critical components in power systems, and the reliability of the electrical system largely depends on their operating conditions. Methods such as open-circuit and short-circuit tests play an important role in transformer design. This study focuses on the investigation of electromagnetic forces. Using finite element models, electromagnetic forces are calculated for two-winding transformer through open-circuit and short-circuit testing applications. Accurate computation of forces during short circuits is crucial for designers, as these forces can lead to damage in transformers. In this work, a three-dimensional model is developed to evaluate the short-circuit forces acting on various phases of a transformer, taking into account the inrush current.

articleTitle: Digital Media Trend Prediction and Future Content Creation Direction Research-Based on Big Data Analysis and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Based on big data analysis and machine learning in digital media trend prediction and future content creation direction fusion effect is poor, no promotion based on big data analysis and machine learning in digital media trend prediction and future content creation direction integration effect and big data analysis effect, so this paper is based on big data analysis and machine learning in digital media trend prediction and future direction of content creation fusion and development in-depth research. Based on the integration and development of big data analysis and digital media trend prediction and future content creation direction in machine learning, First, estimate the development layout of digital media trend prediction and future content creation direction based on big data analysis and machine learning, Using the target detection algorithm to identify the integrated data based on the digital data trend prediction and the future content creation direction in big data analysis and machine learning, Then build a digital feature reconstruction model based on digital media trend prediction and future content creation direction in big data analysis and machine learning, Using algorithm construction to realize the fusion perception of digital media trend prediction and future content creation direction based on big data analysis and machine learning. The simulation experiment results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively improve the effect and satisfaction of digital media trend prediction and future content creation direction fusion based on big data analysis and machine learning, which has certain practical value.

articleTitle: Research on Mine Heat Hazard Risk Assessment and Response Strategies Driven by Advanced Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: The timeliness of the mine thermal hazard risk device data response method system is a kind of energy, resource limited network system, realize the key factors in mine thermal hazard risk energy balance extend the life cycle of the mine thermal hazard risk of the timely response method of system design. This study is based on the practice of mine thermal hazard risk assessment and distribution system of mine thermal hazard risk device driven based on advanced data analysis, and provides several optimization schemes. Among them, the current energy situation of the key factor is considered as a factor in assessing the possibility of conversion, thus enhancing the sustainability of the key factors of the efficient approach in the process of mine thermal hazard risk. Based on the geographic location data of key factors, these data are integrated into the calculation of transition probability, so that key factors remain direction in the process of finding methods. In this study, advanced data analysis drive is used to simulate the optimization strategy, and then compared with the preliminary ACO algorithm. The simulation results show that the optimized strategy is optimized compared with the other two algorithms in terms of increasing the life of key factors and ensuring the energy balance of mine thermal hazard risk.

articleTitle: Advancing Solar Panel Inspections: UAV-Based Detection of Cracks Using YOLO Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Renewable energy sources, particularly solar energy, stand out as vital solutions to global energy and environmental challenges. However, defects such as microscopic or macroscopic cracks in photovoltaic (PV) panels significantly reduce energy production efficiency and system reliability. The rapid, accurate, and autonomous detection of such defects in solar power plants is crucial for reducing efficiency losses and extending the lifespan of PV systems. This study explores the use of advanced object detection algorithms integrated with unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) for solar panel inspections. It evaluates the performance comparison of YOLOv5 and YOLOv7 algorithms in detecting cracks under various lighting conditions, complex backgrounds, and resolutions. To enhance model generalization, a comprehensive dataset was created, encompassing various scenarios such as panel sizes, angles, and lighting conditions. The results reveal that YOLOv7 outperformed YOLOv5 with an 8.01% improvement in precision, an 11.05% improvement in recall, a 10.56% improvement in mean average precision (mAP), and a 9.57% improvement in the F1 score. The study highlights the importance of using object detection algorithms to improve the efficiency of solar power plants.

articleTitle: Maximum Period Pseudo-Random Number Generator Filter Based on Hash Function
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: The development of information technologies allows to significantly increase the efficiency of processing, transmission and storage of information, especially in critical control systems. At the same time, a significant increase in the volume of processed and transmitted data, the development of modern countermeasures puts forward increased requirements for information security. An effective mechanism for protecting information is modern means of cryptographic transformation, including promising methods for generating pseudo-random sequences, which are used as the main component of cryptographic protection subsystems against unauthorized access to automated data processing.

articleTitle: UUVs Navigation Environment Reconstruction Using Active Vision System
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Machine vision is the computer application of vision that enables machines to comprehend their surroundings. The use of machine vision systems in robots allows for more sophisticated and potent operation in real-world applications, such as environmental exploration. In addition to the seafloor of the Unmanned Underwater Vehicle (UUV), a binocular machine active vision system has been used to recreate incomplete or unknown navigation maps. Four processing steps make up the system: frame capture, pre-processing, matching, and depth recovery, which is used to calculate the distance between the object and the system, stored in a relative depth matrix, and, lastly, updating the navigation map.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction with Scalogram-Based CNN Activations and Activity Recognition in Elderly Individuals with Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: The growing elderly population requires healthcare professionals to utilize the Human Activity Recognition (HAR) system accurately and objectively. Wearable sensor technologies offer objective measurement-based HAR methods as a solution. In this study, a signal processing-based deep learning approach was used to assess the daily activities of elderly individuals. The scalogram images, which are the time-frequency representation of Raw signals obtained from three axial accelerometers in the HAR70+ dataset, were used as input to the common Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) with a transfer learning approach. Then, the activations of the global average pooling layer of the CNN networks were used as features of the machine learning algorithms. ResNet18 was the most successful CNN network with 87.37% F1-Score value, while the combination of Xception and LDA was the most successful one with 88.37% F1-Score value during testing.

articleTitle: Optimizing Battery Cooling with Reinforcement Learning: A Dynamic Control Strategy for Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: The growing reliance on energy storage systems (ESS) in residential, vehicular, and industrial applications necessitates efficient thermal management solutions to enhance performance and longevity. This study proposes a reinforcement learning (RL)-based cooling control system for optimizing the temperature regulation of battery banks. Unlike traditional rule-based or static cooling strategies, the proposed method dynamically adjusts coolant flow rates using an Expected SARSA agent, which learns an optimal control policy through interactions with a custom-designed environment model. The model accurately simulates thermal absorption and coolant flow dynamics, allowing for precise and adaptive cooling regulation. The performance of the RL agent was evaluated across different training durations, demonstrating that extended training significantly improves stability, reward consistency, and energy efficiency. Compared to conventional cooling strategies, the RL-based system ensures more adaptive, efficient, and reliable thermal management, making it a promising solution for next-generation energy storage applications.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of EKF and SPKF for SOC Estimation of Lithium-ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: With the increasing prevalence of lithium-ion batteries, advancements are being made in battery management system (BMS) algorithms. One of the most critical parameters for battery safety and performance is the state of charge (SOC). Since directly measuring the remaining charge is not practical, various estimation methods are used. In this study, an equivalent circuit model was developed for the MOLICEL P45B cell used in the battery of an electric vehicle. Based on the developed model and experimental data, a comparison between the EKF and SPKF methods was conducted. According to the results, the SPKF method has better accuracy in SOC estimation than the EKF method.

articleTitle: Review of underwater drones vibration propulsion
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: The vibration propulsion system is an innovative and contemporary approach used in underwater drones. The technique of mechanical vibrations generating motion is accompanied with advantages such as compactness, low power consumption and silent operation, making it highly suitable for underwater applications. This article reviews the basic principles, application, benefits and challenges of vibration propulsion. The guiding principles, reference analytical expressions and general materials distinguished in the described technology are summarized. Relevant vibratory model is presented and analyzed in terms of piezoelectric materials and resulting displacement. Future studies are discussed.

articleTitle: Semi-blind Robust and Quality Assured Watermarking Method for Copyright Protection of Images on Maps System Used in Geographic Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Images in map systems of geographic information systems are easy to access and share, raising significant concerns about copyright protection. One of the most commonly used approaches to protecting copyright is robust watermarking techniques. This paper presents a semi-blind, robust, and quality-assured watermarking method designed to protect the copyrights of images in map systems. Watermark embedding parameters of the proposed method are determined using an optimization algorithm. The performance of the proposed method is assessed using images from various levels of the map system. All images watermarked with the proposed method achieved PSNR values exceeding 40 dB, which is the quality threshold set by the optimization algorithm. Furthermore, the robustness of the method against various attacks, including compression, filtering, and noise addition, was evaluated. The Level 19 image achieved an average NC value of 0.9729, demonstrating the effectiveness of the method against these attacks.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Investigation into Strip Steel Defect Detection using Traditional Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: The steel manufacturing sector places great importance on guaranteeing the quality of strip steel products, which has led to a thorough investigation of defect detection approaches. This work conducts a comparative analysis of traditional machine learning and deep learning models to determine their efficacy in detecting defects in strip steel. Our analysis is based on a dataset that includes a variety of images of strip steel surfaces showing different types of defects. In this work, we adopt image preprocessing techniques to improve the quality of input images prior to the application of classification methods. We employ traditional ML algorithms including Support Vector Machine and Random Forest, and deep learning model AlexNet Convolutional Neural Networks for effective defect classification. Consequently, we present comparative evaluations that highlight the strengths and weaknesses of each approach, considering accuracy scores.

articleTitle: Decision Making in Managing the Choice of UTM-Based Wireless Mapping Systems for Geospatial Data Transmission via LoRa
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Geospatial data visualization and wireless data transmission play a crucial role in modern mapping and navigation systems. This paper presents a tile-based UTM (Universal Transverse Mercator) mapping system designed for ESP32 with integrated LoRa communication. The proposed system enables efficient storage, retrieval, and rendering of vector map data on resource-constrained devices, making it suitable for real-time geographic applications. The map data is stored in a hierarchical folder structure on an SD card, where each tile corresponds to a specific UTM zone and is dynamically loaded based on user navigation. The system supports wireless tile synchronization via LoRa, allowing map data exchange between multiple ESP32 nodes, enabling decentralized and offline-capable mapping solutions. A caching mechanism optimizes memory usage, ensuring smooth map rendering on TFT displays. The proposed solution is particularly useful for remote or low-connectivity environments, where traditional network-based mapping services are unavailable. The paper explores the architecture, implementation, and performance evaluation of the system, highlighting its potential for geospatial applications in UAV navigation, environmental monitoring, and emergency response operations.

articleTitle: Optimized Design of an Automated Drying System for Cataphoresis Exit Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: This research is focused on the creation of an automatic drying line in order to complete the cataphoresis process. The main goal is to ensure high drying efficiency, uniform quality, and low manual intervention. The system incorporates advanced drying processes, efficient air flow mechanisms, and automatic control mechanisms to ensure stable and energy-effective operation. The method is particularly aimed at meeting the operating requirements of modern industrial processes, thus ensuring smoother and more efficient processes.

articleTitle: Error-Corrected Quantum CNN for Gender-Based Micro-Expression Analysis in Affective Computing
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Micro-expression recognition has emerged as a critical area of study in affective computing, with significant applications in psychological analysis, security, and human-computer interaction. However, traditional methods often struggle to accurately capture and interpret subtle, rapid, and gender-specific facial micro-expressions due to challenges such as noise, limited datasets, and variations in expression intensity. This paper introduces an innovative approach, the Error-Corrected Quantum Convolutional Neural Network (EQCNN), to address these challenges and enhance the recognition of gender-based micro-expressions. The proposed EQCNN leverages the principles of quantum computing, incorporating error detection and correction mechanisms within its architecture. By employing quantum unitary gates, Hadamard gates, and CNOT gates, the model ensures data integrity and mitigates the effects of quantum decoherence. Additionally, the framework utilizes a 3π/2 phase shift and logical qubits to correct errors dynamically, optimizing the representation of micro-expression features. To validate the effectiveness of EQCNN, the model was evaluated on a gender-annotated micro-expression dataset. The results demonstrate outstanding performance, achieving an accuracy of 99.3%, an F1-score of 98.9%, a precision of 96.7%, and a recall of 98.4%. Comparative analyses show that EQCNN significantly outperforms classical and quantum-enhanced models, particularly in capturing subtle gender-specific nuances in facial expressions. The findings of this study not only advance the field of micro-expression recognition but also underline the potential of quantum computing in real-world applications requiring high precision and robustness. The proposed EQCNN framework is generalizable and can be extended to other domains involving complex image classification tasks, offering a powerful tool for tackling challenges in quantum-enhanced machine learning.

articleTitle: Fuzzing Based Approach for Vulnerability Detection in Smart Contracts
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Smart contracts are programs that work on blockchain technology and are designed to automatically perform certain operations. Today, smart contracts, especially Ethereum-based ones, are widely used in various fields such as finance, healthcare, supply chain and property management. Unlike traditional contracts, these contracts offer the advantage of executing transactions securely and transparently without the need for any intermediaries. However, due to their security vulnerabilities, they carry the risk of being exploited by malicious attackers. This work proposes a fuzzing-based approach to detect vulnerabilities in smart contracts. The proposed method aims to identify unknown or overlooked potential security vulnerabilities by enabling automatic testing of smart contracts. Within the scope of the study, different fuzzing-based analysis techniques were compared, the advantages and disadvantages of these methods were evaluated. The findings reveal that fuzzing-based testing techniques can be an effective tool in improving the security of smart contracts.

articleTitle: Classification of Ear Diseases from Otoscopic Images Using DenseNet121 and Grow-and-Learn Network
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Diagnosis of ear diseases from otoscopy images is of critical importance to initiate the treatment process accurately and quickly. In this study, a 4-class classification problem is solved using Ear Imagery Database containing images labeled chronic otitis media, earwax plug, myringosclerosis and normal. InceptionV3, Xception, ResNet50, DenseNet121, VGG19 and MobileNet models were used to extract features from images and Grow-and-Learn (GAL) network was used for classification. In GAL network, the number of nodes is automatically adjusted and updated during the training process when needed. The network expands as it learns new information and shrinks as it starts to forget. GAL has a structure similar to KNN (K-Nearest Neighbor) algorithm in the classification phase, but it is a network that can perform higher performance classification with fewer nodes. In this way, it can be used as an alternative to KNN and the classification process can be performed in a shorter time. With this method, ear images were classified into different disease states and the performance of the proposed model was evaluated. Experimental results show that the best performance is achieved with DenseNet121+GAL with a maximum of 98.86% and an average of 97.73%. DenseNet121+KNN achieves a 96.21% success. Experiments show that GAL provides faster and more accurate classification using fewer nodes. This approach can help experts diagnose diseases quickly and accurately, thus providing more effective and timely intervention.

articleTitle: Analysis and Imitation Design of Artificial Intelligence Design Concept of Ancient Buildings
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: The extraction of Guangdong cultural elements and the optimization of artificial intelligence algorithm are an important link in the design and marketing of ancient buildings. High-quality modeling design helps to promote the economic development of ancient architecture design and has an important impact on the development of ancient architecture design. Nowadays, the research on the extraction of Guangdong cultural elements and the optimization of artificial intelligence algorithm mostly focuses on the direction of theoretical research, explaining color collocation, model selection and other aspects, lacks the analysis of imitation design analysis of Guangdong cultural elements extraction and artificial intelligence algorithm optimization, and ignores the direction of application influence of Guangdong cultural elements extraction. In order to further study the ancient architecture design of Guangdong cultural elements extraction and the actual influence of artificial intelligence algorithm optimization, this paper uses the method of combining qualitative and quantitative, using the principal component analysis optimization perceptual factor, combined with ancient imitation design of artificial intelligence algorithm analysis complete design case, the Guangdong cultural element extraction and artificial intelligence algorithm in the process of optimizing theory and practice to provide certain significance. The results show that: combined with ancient imitation design of artificial intelligence algorithm coefficient analysis, ancient architectural design of Guangdong cultural elements of extraction and artificial intelligence algorithm optimization has great influence, thus shows that in proportion, size, color, light, line, building logo, overall style and shape of correlation is stronger, the user satisfaction will be higher.

articleTitle: Research on Application and Optimization of Fintech and Computer Technology in Chinese Commerial Bank Efficiency Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: The current strategy for analyzing the efficiency of Chinese commercial banks, based on fintech and computer technology, suffers from issues of poor accuracy. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved approach to analyzing the efficiency of Chinese commercial banks, leveraging fintech and computer technology. Firstly, preprocessing is conducted to analyze the efficiency of Chinese commercial banks, extracting key characteristic parameters from their information. Subsequently, a multi-chimera identification network tailored for Chinese commercial banks is introduced. This network undergoes initial pre-training, followed by fine-tuning to adapt to the specific task of identifying Chinese commercial banks, thereby facilitating the research on the efficiency analysis strategy. Simulation technology is employed to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. The technical results demonstrate that this approach significantly enhances the identification accuracy and efficiency of Chinese commercial banks, thus possessing substantial application value.

articleTitle: Detection of Tobacco Use through Motion Analysis from Camera Images
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Tobacco use is a widespread form of addiction affecting the health and lives of millions worldwide annually. This thesis proposes an innovative system based on deep learning techniques for automatic and objective detection of tobacco use. The proposed system consists of two main stages. In the first stage, a robust deep learning model using MediaPipe Pose is developed to detect hand-mouth interactions from video or image data. This model can accurately detect these interactions in real-time. In the second stage, a separate deep learning model is designed to estimate and classify hand movements. This model identifies hand movements by detecting key points of the hand skeleton. The hand movement estimation model can classify specific hand movements associated with smoking behavior (e.g., holding a cigarette, bringing it to the mouth, inhaling) with high accuracy. The performance of the developed system has been evaluated through comprehensive experiments and tests. Tests conducted on different dataset demonstrate that the proposed approach can detect tobacco use with high accuracy rates (above 95%). Moreover, the system's ability to operate in real-time and provide fast response times offers a significant advantage for practical applications. The thesis presents the technical details of the proposed system, including the deep learning architectures used, datasets, preprocessing steps, data augmentation techniques, and experimental results. Additionally, potential future applications of the system, its impact on smoking cessation efforts, and possible improvements are discussed.

articleTitle: EfficientFER: EfficientNetv2 Based Deep Learning Approach for Facial Expression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Facial expression recognition (FER), aiming to classify human emotions automatically, is a significant problem in computer vision. Recent advancements in deep learning and computer vision have led to notable progress in FER. This work proposes an enhanced emotion recognition framework utilizing the FER-2013 dataset, augmented with additional training data for improved generalization performance. The EfficientNetv2 architecture is employed with transfer learning for robust and comprehensive feature extraction. The proposed method leverages attention mechanisms to capture critical facial details while mitigating the influence of irrelevant information. The model trained with approximately 23.8 million parameters surpassed the performance of existing methods by classifying with %82.47 accuracy rate on the FER-2013 dataset. These results indicate the potential applicability of the proposed approach to emotion recognition tasks.

articleTitle: Research on Multimodal Data Fusion Technology based on LLM and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: This paper studies the practical method of multimodal data fusion technology in traffic. The practical method of multimodal data fusion technology based on LLM and attention mechanism is proposed, and the analysis model of multimodal data fusion technology is constructed, and the quantitative recursive analysis model is used to analyze the constructed data model to realize the feature extraction of constrained feature data. Then, we study the practical method of traffic multi-modal data fusion technology based on LLM and attention mechanism, optimize the number of neurons in the hidden layer neural network, and complete the practical analysis of traffic multi-modal data fusion technology. The simulation experiment results show that the proposed method in this paper can effectively improve the application efficiency and application effect of traffic multi-mode data fusion technology, and provide professional talents for the development of innovative LLM and attention mechanism.

articleTitle: Analysis of Sustainability in Hydroelectric, Wind, and Solar Energy Systems with Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: The increasing energy demand and environmental sustainability goals have made the effective use of renewable energy sources mandatory. The efficient and sustainable operation of hydroelectric, wind and solar energy systems is of great importance. Artificial intelligence (AI)-based analysis and prediction models increase the performance of these systems and provide optimization in energy production processes. In our study, artificial intelligence-supported analysis methods in hydroelectric, wind and solar energy systems were conducted, and the effects of machine learning and deep learning-based models on sustainable energy production estimates and system efficiency between 1995-2021 were evaluated. The algorithms used in the study aim to increase the accuracy of energy production estimates by utilizing historical data and to better adapt to variable environmental factors. In our study, many comprehensive data sets were used to perform global and regional analysis of hydroelectric, wind and solar energy production. The findings show that artificial intelligence-based models provide significant improvements in production estimates, maintenance planning and resource management in renewable energy systems.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Energy Losses in Oil-Immersed and Dry-Type Transformers According to TEDAŞ MLZ Specifications
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Transformers are vital for the efficient distribution of electrical energy, helping to transfer power across different voltage levels. In this study, we compare the load and no-load losses of dry-type and oil-filled transformers. The transformers are designed according to the TEDAŞ MLZ specifications. By examining their performance characteristics, we determine how efficiently each type operates. The results show significant differences: dry-type transformers tend to have higher load and no-load losses, while oil-filled transformers perform better in both areas. These findings highlight the unique efficiency traits of each transformer type, providing valuable insights for their selection and use in various power distribution scenarios. Overall, this research enhances our understanding of how these transformers differ, aiding in more informed decisions when choosing the right transformer for specific applications.

articleTitle: Binary vs. Multiclass Mental Workload Classification from fNIRS Data: A Deep Learning-Based Subject-Specific Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a portable and non-invasive neuroimaging technique increasingly utilized for mental workload monitoring in cognitive and human-computer interaction studies. In this study, the effectiveness of time-series deep learning models for subject-specific classification of mental workload levels from fNIRS signals was evaluated. Three classification approaches, two binary and one multiclass, were applied using bandpass-filtered and segmented fNIRS data from nine participants selected based on age, gender, handedness, and previous n-back task experience. We used CNN, CNN-GRU, and CNN-LSTM architectures selected for their ability to capture spatial patterns and model temporal dependencies in multivariate sequences. All the models were trained and tested on normalized temporal segments using consistent hyperparameters. Our results revealed that the CNN-LSTM model achieved the highest performance in the binary classification, where label 0 was assigned as low workload and label 2 as high workload, reaching an average test accuracy of 92.35% ± 5.06, F1-score of 0.923 ± 0.051, and AUC of 0.981 ± 0.023.

articleTitle: Digital Curation of Traditional Culture Based on VR and AI Interactive Technology: Taking Art into Schools as an Example
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: This paper explores the innovative use of digital curation, specifically through virtual reality (VR) and artificial intelligence (AI), in preserving and promoting traditional cultural heritage within school curricula. By integrating these technologies, educators and students can engage more deeply with traditional art forms, enhancing cultural understanding and appreciation. Using a systematic literature review (SLR) based on the PRISMA guidelines, this study analyses existing research on the application of digital tools in cultural preservation. The findings indicate that VR and AI increase immersion and interaction, making cultural education more accessible and engaging. Key trends, opportunities, and challenges in deploying these technologies in educational settings are highlighted, alongside gaps in current research and recommendations for future studies. The paper underscores the necessity of adopting digital technologies in education to preserve cultural heritage and foster critical thinking and creativity among students. By bridging traditional cultural practices with modern educational contexts, VR and AI offer significant potential to enrich cultural learning.

articleTitle: Advanced Data Analysis and Feature Extraction Technology in Image Repair
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: With the wide application of image repair, the application of feature extraction technology in image repair has also attracted attention. Therefore, this paper carries out in-depth research on the application of feature extraction technology in image repair with the fusion of advanced data analysis and optimization method. First, the feature extraction algorithm is introduced, and the initial model and the feature extraction are implemented in the image repair. Then, the advanced data analysis and optimization method is adopted to design the feature extraction technology in image repair, construct the feature extraction technology model in image repair, and complete the feature extraction technology in image repair. Simulation experiment results show that the fusion advanced data analysis optimization method of image repair application feature extraction technology accuracy improved significantly, and image repair in the stability of feature extraction technology effect is better, can effectively solve the current image repair application feature extraction technology of low accuracy and low success rate, has certain practical value.

articleTitle: Bridging Genetic Algorithms and Gradient-Based Learning: A Case Study on the Dinosaur Game
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: This paper proposes a hybrid approach that integrates Genetic Algorithms (GA) with derivative-based training for Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) neural networks in the Dinosaur Game environment. GA is employed to generate training data in the absence of existing datasets, and the performance of derivative-based MLP models trained on this data is evaluated. The performances of the various network architectures have been compared with respect to network structure and activation functions. The generalization capability of the network architectures has been assessed on tampered test environment.

articleTitle: Empowering Education Through Virtual Reality-driven Course and Examination System
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: This paper presents the development of "Virtual Academy", a Virtual Reality (VR)-based application designed to ensure uninterrupted access to education, particularly in scenarios where physical attendance in classrooms is challenging. The platform enables students to log in via personal credentials, granting access to assigned courses within an immersive virtual classroom. Teachers and students interact in real-time, with educators leveraging audiovisual tools to enhance the learning experience. The system also supports lesson recording for future reference, evaluates the performance of the students via designated exams, and facilitates a seamless transition to remote learning. By harnessing modern VR technology, Virtual Academy enhances educational continuity and offers an interactive and engaging alternative to traditional learning environments.

articleTitle: Optimized soft voting ensemble model for predicting net blotch disease in spring barley with meteorological data in Turkey
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Early detection of plant diseases helps reduce the use of pesticides in agricultural production and increases productivity. Methods based on meteorological data are successful in predicting plant diseases and weather data are effective in disease development. In this study, a unique ensemble model was proposed to detect the presence of net blotch disease in spring barley in Turkey. Nine different meteorological data collected between 2021-2024 and disease occurrence status were used as data for classification. The performance of 12 different classifiers was evaluated on the collected data. Among them, Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) achieved the highest accuracy with 89.6%. However, while Machine Learning approaches reduce misclassification costs for unbalanced datasets, they struggle to achieve high prediction accuracy. Therefore, the NearMiss-2 method was applied to resolve the class imbalance and 5 different voting-based ensemble approaches including 2,3,4,5 classifiers were proposed and tested to improve the diagnostic accuracy. The results showed that the combination of 3 classifiers consisting of ET, RF and MLP provided an improved classification accuracy of 91.9% and this ensemble method was effective in detecting net blotch disease. For the same model, the precision, recall, f-score and AUC values were 89.5%, 94.4%, 91.9% and 0.945, respectively. The combination of the three classifiers using the majority rule consistently outperformed the classifiers working alone, showing that it facilitates robust decision making by striking a balance between diversity and complexity. The high results obtained showed an improvement in the detection of net blotch in barley compared to previous studies in the literature. It is demonstrated that the model can be used to detect diseases and thus plan pest control methods and pesticide use in crops.

articleTitle: Migraine Analysis with Cross Entropy Based Connectivity Feature: Investigation of Sensory Stimulus Conditions
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Migraine is one of the most common neurological disorders. Despite its high prevalence, the lack of research on migraine compared to other neurological disorders is striking. Visual or auditory sensory stimuli are effective in triggering migraine attacks. The relationships between different brain regions depending on the stimuli can be analyzed with brain connectivity properties by creating a connectivity matrix. In this study, the effect of sensory stimuli in migraine patients is analyzed by entropy-based connectivity analysis and machine learning algorithms Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Artificial Neural Network (ANN) algorithms. At the same time, the classification process was carried out with a healthy control group according to the stimulus conditions in order to contribute to the development of systems that can help diagnose migraine. Unlike previous studies, calculations were made between electrode pairs by applying permutation and conditional Cross Entropy (CE) techniques to Electroencephalography (EEG) signals and connectivity feature matrix or map showing the connection between electrodes was created. In the analysis of the stimulus effect in migraine patients, the most successful classification was obtained between resting and auditory stimulus conditions in the ANN algorithm (Accuracy: 83.68%). In the classification of migraine patients with healthy control group, the ANN algorithm and auditory stimulus condition gave the most successful accuracy rate (Accuracy: 85.71%). According to the analyses in this study, it was determined that the auditory stimulus condition may show significant differences in certain channels in certain regions of the brain of migraine patients compared to visual stimulus and resting conditions and healthy participants. The proposed approach (Fused CE+ANN) has shown successful performance in analyzing the stimulus effect and predicting migraine in migraine patients. Cross entropy techniques can help to discover brain connectivity features that may occur in the brain activity information that may occur especially under stimulus effect.

articleTitle: Leader Selection for Intracompany Projects Using Multi-Criteria Decision Making Techniques
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: This paper presents an innovative decisionmaking model for improving the process of selecting and deploying leaders’ intracompany projects. The Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) is used to develop a systematic approach to selecting team leaders. This approach matches the individual competencies of leaders with the requirements of projects. The study evaluates leaders on criteria such as self-confidence, strategic thinking, teamwork experience, crisis management and communication skills. These criteria, developed through an extensive literature review and expert opinion, allowed the candidates to be ranked and assigned to the most appropriate projects. As part of the study, in a hypothetical company with 10 leadership candidates, the individuals were assessed against the leadership criteria and each candidate's suitability for the projects was rated. The scores of the candidates were normalized between 1 and 10 and the leaders were categorized as "very competent", "moderately competent" and "less competent". According to the results, the highest scoring leader candidate L1 was placed in the "highly competent" category with a score of 10, while the lowest scoring leader candidate L9 and L10 were placed in the "less competent" category with a score of 2.57.

articleTitle: Identification and Interpretation of Focal Center of Brain Activity from EEG Signal Recordings
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: The aim of this study is to analyze the signal generated in the brain for a specific task and to identify the region where it occurs. For this purpose, EEG signals were divided into delta, theta, alpha and beta sub-frequency bands, and feature extraction was performed by looking at the time-frequency characteristics of the signals belonging to the obtained sub-frequency bands. Time and focal center were determined by matching the time and frequency band at which the thought occurred. In this study, a hand open-close example was studied. A deep learning structure was used for signal recognition and interpretation. Promising results were obtained in relation to signal recognition and action realization.

articleTitle: Integration of Sustainability and Civic Moraity in New-Era Educational Technology: Methods for Developing Digital Tools for Lifelong Learning and Social Responsibility
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: In view of the new era of education technology sustainability and the integration of civic moral digital tool system fusion effect is poor, not improve the new era of education technology sustainability and the effect of civic moral integration and energy saving effect, so this paper on the new era of education technology sustainability and the integration of civic moral digital tool system integration and development of further research. Based on the research on the integration and development of sustainability and civic morality in the new era of educational technology, First, estimate the layout of social responsibility development of the integrated digital tool system of sustainability and civic morality in the new era, Using a target detection algorithm to identify objects with the integration of sustainability and civic morality in new era educational technologies, Then we construct the visual feature reconstruction model of the integrated digital tool system of sustainability and civic morality in the new era education technology, Using algorithms to build the fusion perception of the integrated digital tool system of sustainability and civic morality in the new era education technology. The simulation experiment results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively improve the effect and satisfaction of the sustainability and civic morality in the new era, which has certain practical value.

articleTitle: Impact of Image Filtering Techniques on Deep Learning-Based Kidney Disease Classification Using CT scans
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Medical images are one of the most effective tools that is required for automated diagnosis because of its ability to capture pictorial view of an infected area or region. In any classification task that has to do with medical diseases, medical images are very useful to achieve such task. The more the region of interest is visible to the deep learning model or tool, it increases the chances of accurate classification and accuracy of detection. This study evaluates the impact of image enhancement strategy such has the application of image processing filters such has Gaussian blur, Median filter and bilateral filters to different kidney diseases such as Cyst, Tumor, and stone to evaluate the impact of image filters on deep learning models specifically in this case VGG 19. The result for indicated that image filtering methods has some influence on the deep learning performance by enhancing feature extraction and noise reduction. Gaussian blur filter has a 97% accuracy which outperforms others, bilateral filter had an accuracy of 96%, median filter and no filter resulted in a 95% accuracy of the deep learning model. This suggest that noise in CT imaging has the ability to negatively impact classification and that not all filtering techniques has the ability to equally enhance performance.

articleTitle: Optimizing Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search for Fashion Image Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: In this study, we conduct a comparative evaluation of the Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) algorithm, as well as Inverted File Index (IVF) and Product Quantization (PQ), analyzing their impact on search accuracy, indexing time, and query performance. We experiment with embeddings extracted from the Fashionpedia dataset using ResNet-101, with additional dimensionality reduction via Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for performance comparison. Furthermore, we incorporate category-based filtering to enhance retrieval relevance. Our findings provide insights into the trade-offs between recall, efficiency, and memory usage, offering practical guidelines for optimizing ANN-based indexing techniques in visual recommendation tasks.

articleTitle: Artificial intelligence in sustainable supplier search: A comprehensive bibliometric analysis using Scopus database
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Sustainable suppliers play a crucial role in achieving environmental, social, and economic goals in procurement. By prioritizing sustainable suppliers, organizations can create a more resilient, efficient, and responsible supply chain that aligns with broader sustainability objectives and stakeholder expectations. On the other hand, Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly growing and evolving, and the integration of AI across various industries is not only reshaping business operations but also influencing daily life and economic structures. However, the application of AI in supply chain management (in the context of sustainable suppliers), is rather limited. Therefore, the main objective of this research study is to contribute to the organization and analysis of scientific literature related to the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in studies revolving around sustainable suppliers. Utilizing the R studio’s Bibliometrix bibliometric tool and quantitative approach, the research identifies patterns and trends in publications globally. The key terms "SUSTAINABLE SUPPLIER" and "ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE" were used for search of one of the most renowned global scientific databases, namely the Scopus scientific database. The findings of the bibliometric study of 140 papers reveals significant insights, including the scarcity of empirical research in sustainable supplier search with the application of artificial intelligence. Moreover, identification of key research themes and current trend topics, the annual scientific production, the most relevant authors, the most cited countries, the most cited and relevant articles, the most relevant sources, the most relevant affiliations, the co-occurrence network, the most frequent words as well as visualization of thematic map and word cloud associated with sustainable suppliers and artificial intelligence. The publications synthesis should serve as a basis for policymakers, procurement departments and procurement management, and researchers navigating the evolving application of AI in sustainable supplier search.

articleTitle: Importance Of AI In Acoustic Emission Testing and Enhancement Provided Through Compound AI
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Acoustic emission has evolved as one of the essential non-destructive testing methods for railway track monitoring. The growing complexity of railway infrastructure, artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming AE testing by the automation of defect detection and classification. This paper presents a extensive review of literature on the use of AI techniques for AE testing, assessing their advantages, limitations, and the promise of compound AI models. Standalone methods like Artificial Neural ANN (Artificial Neural Networks), SVM (Support Vector Machines), CNN (Convolutional Neural Networks) offer an efficient feature extraction and classification but suffers away from data dependency, computation costs, and temporal analysis. Compound models—like CNN with Combine LSTM or Random Forest with CNN—improve accuracy by taking advantage of complementary strengths. The AI for AE testing futures research will focus on integrating for better transparency and decision making — such as Explainable AI (XAI). AI-driven AE Real time monitoring, reduced manual intervention, and better defect prediction are provided by testing. enhancing safety and efficiency within rail networks.

articleTitle: Modelling Humanoid Robot Audition for Sound Source Localization Using Artifical Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: This study presents a new method for computational auditory systems that models humanoid robot audition for determining the direction of a sound source and integrates it into the Arslan humanoid robot. It does this by employing artificial neural networks. With an emphasis on precision and flexibility, the study provides a workable answer for real-world applications. The encouraging outcomes confirm the system's approach's efficacy and its potential for practical uses. In order to get greater precision and flexibility in practical applications, the study also tackles some constraints. The outcomes show encouraging accuracy rates for a range of sample sizes, highlighting the suggested method's scalability and dependability.

articleTitle: Maximizing Energy Efficiency in a Solar Tracking System Using IoT-Based Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: This paper presents an IoT-based solar tracking system that uses image processing to improve solar energy efficiency. A fixed camera is used to capture video frames of the sun, and these frames are processed in real time using the OpenCV library. By applying HSV thresholding and contour detection, the system finds the sun’s bright area and calculates its azimuth and elevation angles.The angles are formatted as JSON and sent to the ThingsBoard IoT platform via MQTT. On the platform, a dashboard shows real-time data using charts, radial gauges, and alarm indicators. The system also uses the Hottel model to calculate theoretical solar radiation and compares it with the image-based results.To show how the system could be used in real life, a control algorithm was written to move a servo motor based on the azimuth angle. This part of the system hasn’t been tested with hardware yet, but the Python code is ready to run on a Raspberry Pi.The simulation results show that the system tracks the sun accurately and provides consistent data when compared to theoretical values. The combination of image processing, IoT communication, and automation makes this system a simple and low-cost solution for solar tracking.

articleTitle: Development of a Virtual Reality Traffic Simulation to Analyze Road User Behavior
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: Traffic safety researchers from various disciplines, including transportation, psychology, education, and health, frequently use virtual reality (VR) traffic simulations in game engines (e.g., Unity) to study road user behavior. A critical limitation of many such studies is simplified traffic simulation, including simplified vehicle-to-vehicle interactions in which vehicles do not respond realistically to each other. This shortcoming may limit the accuracy and practical relevance of the findings for real-world traffic safety improvements. Traffic simulation software such as Simulation of Urban Mobility (SUMO) provides comprehensive traffic simulation based on car-following and lane-changing models, and additional components such as posted speed limit compliance, turning movement behaviors, right-of-way rules, and intersection controls. In this study, we developed a framework for a VR traffic simulation in which a VR user can interact with traffic vehicles generated by SUMO micro-simulation. We developed a process for creating a road network, and a process for integrating SUMO with Unity. We also generated a performance function to evaluate the integration performance. The results showed that the integration successfully generated a realistic traffic simulation.

articleTitle: Application of Internet of Things Technology in Sustainable Community Environmental Monitoring and Governance
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: This paper examines the appropriateness of IoT technology in Barcelona’s smart city concerning green management of the community. The cross-sectional qualitative case study research approach adopted for the study involves determining the types of IoT apparatus deployed, difficulties experienced when deploying the IoT devices, and the relationship between IoT and transparency, communicative participation, and decision-making in environmental governance. The study proves that IoT devices including air quality sensors, water quality sensors, and smart waste management have enhanced the availability of real-time environmental data in Barcelona. This has helped to improve it through guesswork and has also resulted in increased accountability to the public. That said, challenges such as high-cost incidences, lack of technical skills, and data security concerns act as a thorn in the side of organisations willing to leverage IoT to its optimum. Considering all these, the study affirms that IoT has a large capacity to positively influence sustainable governance if equal access to technology and adequate social support is offered especially in deprived society sectors.

articleTitle: Reducing chattering by hybrid control of a DFIG-based wind power system
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: With the challenges of energy transition and the need to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, wind power is establishing itself as a clean, sustainable source of renewable energy. Optimizing the conversion of this energy requires advanced control strategies to ensure efficient and stable production even under variable wind conditions. This article proposes a hybrid control approach for a doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) integrated in a wind energy system, combining the resilience of sliding mode control (SMC) and the flexibility of backstepping. The approach adopted starts with the mathematical modelling of the hybrid controller and then its application to the two converters. The benefits of the proposed strategy is evaluated by means of simulations carried out in MATLAB/Simulink. The outcomes show a significant improvement in terms of stability, dynamic response and robustness to external disturbances and variations in operating conditions.

articleTitle: Application of Digital Twin and Augmented Reality Fusion in Remote Maintenance of Complex Equipment
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: At present, the application of remote maintenance effect of complex equipment based on the fusion data of digital twins and augmented reality has poor accuracy. Therefore, this paper studies the application of remote maintenance effect of complex equipment of digital twins and augmented reality for this problem. The application model of remote maintenance effect of complex equipment based on data optimization of multi-digital twins and augmented reality is proposed. Firstly, principal component analysis is used to select the application index of remote maintenance effect of complex equipment based on data optimization of digital twins and augmented reality. Then through more digital twins and augmented reality fusion data optimization establish complex equipment remote maintenance effect application system, by many digital twins and augmented reality fusion data optimization of input layer and hidden layer and fusion layer node build vector index, the connection weight and threshold fusion value calculation, complete digital twins and augmented reality fusion data optimization complex equipment remote maintenance effect. The simulation experiment results show that the fusion data of digital twin and augmented reality for remote maintenance of complex equipment has the best application effect and short application time, which can effectively improve the application accuracyt.

articleTitle: Websites Quality and Online Success: A Bibliometric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: This bibliometric study examines the evolution of literature related to website quality, emphasizing its impact on user engagement, satisfaction, trust, and overall institutional performance. High-quality websites attract and retain users, fostering better customer relationships and driving business success. Key dimensions such as design, usability, accessibility, performance, and content relevance are explored through a comprehensive literature analysis. The study employs bibliometric techniques, including descriptive analysis and science mapping, using data retrieved from the Web of Science database covering the period from 2005 to 2024. A total of 1,162 articles are analyzed, highlighting influential authors, citation patterns, and core research themes. The findings reveal the interdisciplinary nature of website quality research, with significant contributions from the fields of information systems, e-commerce, and human-computer interaction. By providing a thorough examination of how website quality is conceptualized and measured, this study offers valuable insights for both academic research and practical website evaluations.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of M5 and MOH Core Materials in Dry-Type Transformers Electromagnetic Performance and Cost Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: The aim of this study is to evaluate and compare the electromagnetic performance, cost evaluation and comparison of M5 and MOH used as core materials in dry type transformers. Under the same conditions, finite element method (FEM) based simulations are carried out in ANSYS Maxwell simulation program and analyses as magnetic flux density distribution, core losses, energy density and operating current are performed. While the M5 type core made of oriented grain silicon steel has the advantage of being able to reach high magnetic saturation levels, it also causes increased hysteresis and eddy current losses. While the amorphous MOH core is considered, more stable magnetic behavior and lower hysteresis and eddy losses are observed. MOH material has shown potential for long-term savings due to increased efficiency and decreased energy losses. The obtained results are provided a solid reference for transformer designers and manufacturers searching for the most suitable core material for energy-saving and high-performance transformer applications.

articleTitle: Investigation of structural response of active acoustic metamaterial cell
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: In this study, a voice coil actuator based active acoustic metamaterial has been designed and fabricated. The metamaterial is formed by combining two membranes of different thicknesses activated by a voice coil actuator. The voice coil actuator contains of a magnet and a coil. Here, two separate membrane elements are manufactured for the coil side and the magnet side and one of them is designed to move with the coil and the other with the magnet. After the necessary assembly operations are carried out, the structure moves together as a result of the input applied to the actuator. In this study, various membrane types were used for the cell structure. The effect of these membrane types on the frequencies of the cell structure in the air gap has been experimentally investigated. In addition, a theoretical model was created and validated by comparing the outputs obtained with the experimental results.

articleTitle: High-Efficiency LLC Resonant Converter For LED Driver Applications
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: High efficiency and reliable power supplies are critically important, especially for modern applications such as LED lighting systems. Resonant converters are widely used in such applications due to their ability to provide high efficiency and energy density. Among these, LLC resonant converters are the most common topology due to its soft switching ability over a wide operating range. In this paper, the analysis and design of an LLC resonant converter for LED lighting applications is presented. To validate the proposed design and analysis, a 75 W LLC resonant converter prototype is developed specifically for LED applications. Experimental results demonstrated that 96% efficiency is obtained. The experimental results confirm the accuracy of the high-efficiency and low-power-loss analysis, proving that the LLC topology delivers high performance and efficiency in LED applications.

articleTitle: Multilingual and Multi-Class Sentiment Classification Using Machine Learning, BERT, and GPT-4o-mini
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: In this study, we investigate multilingual and multiclass sentiment classification by analyzing datasets in Turkish, English, and Italian. The proposed approach consists of three main stages: sentence representation extraction, classification, and performance evaluation. First, sentence representations were extracted from these datasets using the distiluse-base-multilingual-cased-v1, sentence-transformers/LaBSE, and Alibaba-NLP/gte-multilingual-base models. These representations were then used as input for Logistic Regression (LR), Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forest (RF), and Naive Bayes (NB). Additionally, fine-tuned BERT-base-multilingual-cased and GPT-4o-mini were directly employed as end-to-end models. The classification performance of the models was evaluated using accuracy, F1-score, precision, and recall. Additionally, a confusion matrix analysis was conducted for each dataset to examine classification performance in detail. The experimental results show the influence of embedding models and learning algorithms on multilingual multi-class sentiment classification.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality-Assisted Surgical Guidance System for Kidney Nephrectomy with Remote Expert Consultation
publicationTitle: 2025 7th International Congress on Human-Computer Interaction, Optimization and Robotic Applications (ICHORA)
abstract: This paper represents an augmented reality(AR)-assisted surgical guide system with a novel teleconsultation-assisted system that enables remote expert consultation during partial nephrectomy operations. The system includes three components: a surgical planning software, a virtual reality-based surgical guidance software and a web- based teleconsultation software. Deep learning based kidney segmentations, along with the annotation of the generated masks, are performed in the surgical planning application using three- dimensional patient imaging. The real-time tracking data from region of interest (ROI) is used for localization with the usage of fiducial markers. Using this positional data, patient images are aligned and registered within the intraoperative space. The teleconsultation component allows remote experts to view the surgeons AR display, communicate via vioce and send annotated images of the surgical site for surgical guidance purposes. The proposed framework aims to bridge the gap between on-site and remote surgical expertise, improving accessibility and efficienct in surgical prodecures.
